0022600230.text: The Phoenix Suns (4-6, 4-3 at home, 0-3 on the road) host the Charlotte Hornets (4-7, 1-3 on the road) in the Suns' 11th game of the season, with Phoenix 11th in the West and Charlotte 9th in the East. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix with shoulder surgery, while Charlotte is without Brandon Miller (groin soreness), Dennis Schroder (hamstring strain), and Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and their most recent meeting was a 127-107 Charlotte win in Charlotte on April 2, 2026, with no games yet in the 2026-27 season series.
